We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. We have carbon NMR data with chemical shifts: 88.85, 69.70, 68.60, 67.50, 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, 14.05. Aromatic carbons typically appear around 110-160 ppm. None of these are in that range. So likely zero aromatic carbons. But maybe the molecule has aromatic carbons but not observed? The data suggests all aliphatic. So answer 0.

Check if any other tool needed? Could retrieve carbon shift ranges for aromatic to confirm.
